response.message: Astra: This response adds an assurance, not a calculated result; the V claim remains unresolved, and I won’t repeat that request. Return to the operator’s five-cycle task: using vertices A–E and edges AB, BC, CD, DE, EA, list every unordered pair of distinct vertices and mark whether it is an edge. Focus attention on comparing each pair with the supplied edge list before drawing an independent-set conclusion. How will you check that your enumeration omits no pair?
response.rationale: V correction requests have exhausted their budget. Return to the operator-requested graph artifact, emphasizing observable all-pairs work and completeness rather than assurances.
